title: Sr. Forward Deployed Data Engineer
description: POSITION SUMMARY: Natera is a global leader in cell-free DNA testing, serving patients across oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our Data & AI organization builds the enterprise data platform and AI systems that turn clinical, genomic, and operational data into products that improve patient care and accelerate the business. We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Data Engineer to work directly with internal business stakeholders and domain teams to design, build, and deploy high-impact analytics and AI solutions. Reporting directly to the Data & AI Engineering Tech Lead, you will act as the technical point-of-contact and primary builder for stakeholder initiatives, translating business needs into production-ready data and AI products. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role where you will write production code, develop semantic layers, and implement agentic workflows and LLM pipelines. As a forward deployed engineer, you are AI-native by design—using AI coding harnesses and agentic tooling to accelerate development, testing, and documentation. You will partner closely with the Tech Lead to adopt foundational architecture patterns while rapidly delivering tailored solutions in a regulated environment where data quality, lineage, and privacy are essential. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering fundamentals with a customer-obsessed mindset, pragmatic problem-solving, and the communication skills needed to bridge complex technical solutions and business outcomes.   Key Responsibilities Stakeholder Engagement & Technical Ownership Embed closely with business stakeholders to deeply understand their data and AI requirements, serving as their primary technical advisor and engineer. Run launch discovery and impact analysis for new assays or products (models, views, dashboards touched), documented in Confluence and Jira. Translate complex business challenges into clear technical specs and deliverable milestones, partnering with the Tech Lead to align with enterprise architecture standards. Adhere to established engineering standards for pipeline design, data modeling, testing, version control (Git/GitLab branching, MRs, PRs) and CI/CD, ensuring deployed solutions are reliable and maintainable. Hands-On Solutions Engineering Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and transformations on our cloud data platform, sourcing clinical, laboratory, operational, and commercial data to serve business analytics. Develop governed data models and semantic layers that power self-service analytics, dashboards, and data products (e.g., Patient 360, Provider 360, Test 360) for business teams. Develop AI solutions to enable business productivity and automation through use of agentic workflows, RAG/retrieval, and LLM pipelines (extraction/classification) Write production-grade SQL and Python; contribute to shared frameworks, templates, and tooling that let the team deliver new analytics solutions faster. Ensure the data layer supports performant, trustworthy analytics and LLM querying ; lead root-cause analysis on complex data issues and drive durable fixes.   AI-Native Execution & Continuous Learning Leverage AI coding assistants and agentic tools daily across the full software development lifecycle to accelerate solution development and deployment speed. Apply AI-native engineering best practices—such as prompt engineering, agentic workflows, and automated testing—to maximize individual output while upholding high quality. Collaborate with the Tech Lead and peer engineers through code reviews, technical sharing, and feedback to continually refine forward deployed engineering practices. Data Quality, Reliability & Compliance Implement data quality checks, contracts, lineage, and monitoring so that downstream consumers can trust the data by default. Own operational excellence for the team’s solutions: SLAs, incident response, and cost efficiency of compute and storage. Ensure pipelines handling PHI and genomic data meet HIPAA, CLIA, and internal security and governance requirements, including access controls, auditability, and retention. Cross-Functional Partnership Work directly with business stakeholders across functions to understand their questions, shape analytics solutions to their needs, and communicate technical tradeoffs in plain language. Collaborate with core platform and AI teams under the guidance of the Tech Lead to build solutions on enterprise foundations rather than isolated silos. Represent the team in architecture forums, data governance discussions, and tool evaluations.   Qualifications Required 7+ years of data or software engineering experience, with a track record of forward-deployed or customer-facing engineering roles delivering analytics and AI solutions directly to stakeholders. Proven ability to partner directly with non-technical business partners, translate technical concepts clearly, and manage project deliverables. Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI coding assistants and agentic tools in daily engineering work, with a point of view on how to use them well. Expert-level SQL and strong Python, with a track record of shipping and operating production data pipelines and data models at scale. Deep experience with a modern cloud data warehouse and cloud infrastructure (Snowflake/AWS preferred). Hands-on experience with transformation frameworks (dbt or equivalent) and workflow orchestration (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, or similar). 1-2 years of practical background building with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or equivalent) alongside managed AI services and model routing gateways like Snowflake Cortex, AWS Bedrock, and foundational APIs. Strong grounding in analytical data modeling (dimensional or domain-driven), semantic layers, data quality engineering, and CI/CD for data systems. Preferred Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or another regulated domain handling PHI or other sensitive data. Experience with lab data management systems, lab informatics systems, bioinformatics pipelines is a plus Snowflake experience, including performance tuning, cost management, and features such as dynamic tables, Snowpark, or Cortex. Sigma experience, or experience with comparable BI and semantic-layer tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI), and an understanding of how to design data models for self-service consumption. Working knowledge of Power BI, including dataset design, data source connectivity, and troubleshooting dashboards when upstream data changes. Experience building and operating agentic or LLM-based workflows within the data development lifecycle. Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and data observability tooling. Experience integrating with Salesforce, laboratory information systems, or EHR data sources. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience. The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations. Remote USA $125,000 — $156,300 USD OUR OPPORTUNITY Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management. WHAT WE OFFER Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program! For more information, visit www.natera.com . Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws. If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents.  Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/ Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @ natera.com  email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes. For more information: - BBB announcement on job scams   - FBI Cyber Crime resource page

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Machinify is a leading healthcare intelligence company with expertise across the payment continuum, delivering unmatched value, transparency, and efficiency to health plan clients across the country. Deployed by over 85 health plans, including many of the top 20, and representing more than 270 million lives, Machinify brings together a fully configurable and content-rich, AI-powered platform along with best-in-class expertise. We’re constantly reimagining what’s possible in our industry, creating disruptively simple, powerfully clear ways to maximize financial outcomes and drive down healthcare costs. Machinify builds AI-powered software that helps health plans pay claims accurately. As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build and run the data pipelines and models behind our payer-facing products, and help bring legacy data processes over into a common platform. You'll extend and integrate tooling along the way so the results can be reused by partner teams, not just our own. This is a broad engineering role. You'll own pipelines end to end: ingestion, modeling, quality, deployment and day-to-day operations, in an AI-assisted engineering environment. What You’ll Do Design, build and operate reliable, automated data pipelines for health plan data. Model complex, messy healthcare data into clear, trustworthy canonical and analytical models. Bring legacy processes, pipelines and models over into a common platform, preserving the logic and behavior that already work. Extend and integrate tools and workflows so other teams can adopt them. Build in data quality and software engineering discipline: validation, automated testing, code review, CI/CD. Document what you build and review AI-generated work critically.    What You Bring   5+ years in data engineering, including production ownership of the pipelines you built. Strong SQL and Python. Strong data modeling: canonical and dimensional design, conflicting sources, history, adjustments. You can explain why a model is shaped the way it is. Production dbt and workflow orchestration (Airflow or similar). Expertise with Snowflake and/or Databricks, Spark SQL experience Data quality and CI/CD practices applied to data: validation and reconciliation, pull requests, automated tests, deployment automation. Generalist range: you can take a broad, loosely defined problem and run it end to end across ingestion, modeling, infrastructure, APIs and operations, including incident response, and you onboard a new data source from discovery to delivery. A record of extending or integrating existing tools and building things other teams use. Quick, deep learning of complex domains: you ask why the data looks the way it does, and you verify AI-generated code and abstractions against ground truth. Good intuition on how to leverage AI in development and automation in day-to-day engineering practices, understands how to leverage AI as a force multiplier for efficiency, and potential risk Strongly Preferred:  Payment integrity experience, especially coordination of benefits and third-party liability (COB/TPL), cost avoidance, and Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP). Related areas such as post-pay audit, subrogation, overpayment recovery and claims editing are also of interest. Healthcare claims data experience (837/835/UB-04, eligibility, member and provider data, DRG). Experience building your own AI skills, MCP tools, and plugins Large-scale batch file ingestion (SFTP and cloud storage, EDI X12, fixed-width, CSV/Parquet) and schema drift handling. Automation: GitHub Actions, infrastructure-as-code, and turning recurring data operations into tested, repeatable workflows. experience with Scala Strong AWS experience. BI exposure, such as semantic or cube modeling. AI engineering: building your own agent tools, MCP servers, skills or plugins. Spark performance tuning, data contracts and schema governance, HIPAA/PHI handling. 🌱 Why Join Us   Real impact — your pipelines will directly support decision-making and claims payment outcomes from day one.   High visibility — partner with ML, Product, Analytics, Platform, Operations, and Customer teams on critical data initiatives.   Total ownership — you’ll drive the lifecycle of core datasets powering our platform.   Customer-facing impact  — you will directly contribute to successful  customer onboarding  and data integration.   What We Offer     Work from anywhere in the US! Machinify is digital-first.    Full Medical/Dental/Vision for employees & their families    Flexible and trusting environment where you’ll feel empowered to do your best work    Unlimited FTO    Competitive salary, equity, 401(k) including employer match    The base salary range for this role is $180,000 - $220,000. The salary for this position is based on an array of factors unique to each candidate: Such as years and depth of experience, set skills, certifications, etc. We are hiring for different levels, and our Recruiting team will let you know if you qualify for a different role/range. Salary is one component of the total compensation package, which includes meaningful equity, excellent healthcare, flexible time off, and other benefits and perks.     Equal Employment Opportunity at Machinify   We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Machinify is an employment at will employer. We participate in E-Verify as required by applicable law. In accordance with applicable state laws, we do not inquire about salary history during the recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application or recruitment process, please let our recruiters know. See our Candidate Privacy Notice at:  https://www.machinify.com/candidate-privacy-notice/

location: California, USA; Colorado, USA; Connecticut, USA; Florida, USA; Georgia, USA; Illinois, USA; Kansas, USA; Maine, USA; Maryland, USA; Massachusetts, USA; Melbourne, Victoria, Australia; New Jersey, USA; New South Wales, Australia; New York, USA; North Carolina, USA; Ohio, USA; Oregon, USA; Tennessee, USA; Texas, USA; Virginia, USA; Washington, USA
description: About us NinjaOne unifies IT to simplify work for nearly 40,000 customers in 140+ countries The NinjaOne Unified IT Operations Platform delivers endpoint management, autonomous patching, backup, and remote access in a single console to improve efficiency, increase resilience, and reduce spend. By automating IT and managing all endpoints, organizations give employees a great technology experience at work. NinjaOne is obsessed with customer success and has retained a 98% customer satisfaction score for more than 5 years. About the Role At NinjaOne, we're looking for a skilled Senior Data Engineer to join our Emerging Products team and help build the foundation of our modern data platform. You'll play a critical role in designing and scaling lakehouse architectures, building robust streaming and batch pipelines, and ensuring data flows reliably to the analysts and data scientists who depend on it. This is an exciting opportunity to work on greenfield infrastructure using a cutting-edge stack — Kafka, Spark, Iceberg, and Databricks — collaborate with cross-functional teams, and help shape how we harness data to power our next generation of products. Location - We are flexible on remote working from home, if you are located in the USA and reside in one of the following states - CA , CO , CT , FL , GA , *IL , KS , MA , MD , ME , NJ , NC , NY , OH , OR , TN , TX , VA , and WA . We have physical offices in Austin, TX and Tampa, FL, if you prefer a hybrid option. *Onsite interviews may be required for this role. We hire the best software engineers, but experience in our stack can’t hurt: NinjaOne is built on Java, Kotlin, C++, Golang and Postgres; supporting millions of user endpoints and running as a scalable cloud service in AWS.  Knowing large-scale datastore bottlenecks, asynchronous application design and client-server architecture will help you. What You’ll be Doing Lakehouse Architecture: Design and implement Medallion-layer data architectures (Bronze, Silver, Gold), building structured ingestion pipelines and curated data layers that serve downstream analytics and data science workloads. Pipeline Development: Build and maintain scalable streaming and batch data pipelines using Kafka, Spark, and Airflow, supporting reliable and low-latency data movement across the platform. Table Format Management: Own and manage open table formats including Iceberg, Delta, and Hudi — selecting the right format for the workload and maintaining performance and reliability at scale. Query Engine Optimization: Work with Trino/Starburst and Databricks-based environments to optimize large-scale analytics queries and support platform consumers. Platform Reliability: Monitor pipeline health, troubleshoot data quality and performance issues, and continuously improve the reliability and efficiency of the data platform. Collaboration: Partner closely with data scientists, analysts, and product teams to understand data requirements and deliver platform solutions that enable data-driven decision-making. Other duties as needed About You Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience preferred. 10+ years of experience in data engineering with a strong focus on data platform and distributed systems. Hands-on experience building and managing lakehouse architectures, including Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) layering patterns. Deep expertise in Apache Kafka, Apache Spark, and Apache Airflow for both streaming and batch pipeline development. Proficiency in open table formats — Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi — with the ability to evaluate trade-offs and select the right format for the workload. Experience with Databricks for large-scale data processing and analytics workloads. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience that will make you a standout candidate: Hands-on experience with Trino or Starburst for distributed query execution Familiarity with hybrid streaming/batch architectures and event-driven data systems. Experience designing Gold-layer datasets optimized for business intelligence and self-serve analytics. What You’ll Love  We are a collaborative, kind, and curious community. We honor your flexibility needs with full-time work that is hybrid remote. We have you covered with our comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance. We help you prepare for your financial future with our 401(k) plan. We prioritize your work-life balance with our unlimited PTO. We reward your work with opportunity for growth and advancement. Due to federal government security requirements associated with our FedRAMP-authorized environment, candidates must be U.S. citizens or lawful permanent residents. *Due to operational policies, NinjaOne is unable to hire for this role within the city limits of Chicago. We will consider all qualified candidates who reside outside of the city proper or are willing to self-relocate. #LI-MM1 #LI-REMOTE   Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to location, market demands, experience, job-related knowledge, and skills. title: Senior Data Engineer
description: ABOUT MUX Mux is video for developers and their agents. We handle the hard problems of video, like encoding, streaming, delivery, and monitoring, along with the hard problem of understanding it: turning raw footage into context, structure, and answers. Video is a huge part of people’s lives, and we want to help make it not just playable, but understandable. We’re committed to building a healthy team that welcomes a diverse range of backgrounds and experiences. We want people who care about our mission, are ready to grow, believe in our values (from Be Human to Turn Customers Into Fans), and want to make the people around them better. You’ll be joining a tight-knit team with experience at places like Google, YouTube, Twitch, Zencoder, Fastly, and more. Our founders previously started (and sold) Zencoder, an early leader in cloud video technology, and authored Video.js, the biggest HTML5 video player on the web. We organize Demuxed, the premiere conference for video engineers in the world. We’re backed by top investors like Coatue, Accel, Andreessen Horowitz, and Y Combinator. You’ll get to work with amazing companies: hundreds of startups, plus Patreon, Substack, Synthesia, and HubSpot. Customers large and small love working with us and love our team. We are building something big together. We’d love to hear from you! ABOUT THE ROLE Mux makes video easy for developers. Our APIs handle encoding, streaming, playback and analytics for companies like Patreon, Substack and Robinhood. We're changing how Mux uses its own data. We're not building more dashboards. We're building semantic models that are clean, tested and well documented, and putting AI agents on top of them so anyone at Mux can ask a question in Slack and get a correct answer. Agents on top of bad data just give confident wrong answers faster. So this role is fundamentally a data engineering role: the warehouse, the pipelines and the dbt models have to be right before any of the AI work is worth anything. As a Senior Data Engineer on the Analytics team, you'll own the Mux data stack end to end, from ingestion through Snowflake and dbt to the semantic layer the agents query. The team is small, so you'll have a broad scope and your work will be visible. You'll also be expected to use AI tools heavily in your own work, and to help decide where they belong in the data stack and where they don't. This role is a fit if you want to build the foundation an AI-native analytics function runs on, and you'd rather delete a model than add another one. WHAT YOU'LL DO OWN THE DATA PLATFORM END TO END - Own the Mux data warehouse (Snowflake), the ingestion layer and the transformation layer (dbt): architecture, administration, permissions, CI/CD, cost, ingestion standards and data quality - Build and maintain ingestion from production systems and business tools (Fivetran or equivalent) into the warehouse, and keep it in sync as the product changes - Run the platform day to day: orchestration, deployments, environment management, and incident response when something breaks - Push curated data back out to business systems like Salesforce, NetSuite and HubSpot SEMANTIC MODELS AND AGENTS - Build the semantic models and data foundation behind the agents people at Mux use to answer business questions - Help measure whether those agents give correct answers DATA QUALITY AND RELIABILITY - Keep the data accurate, tested and simple: move logic upstream, enforce contracts, and add observability - Pay down tech debt as you go and leave the codebase simpler than you found it WORK AI-FORWARD - Use coding agents (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor) as a normal part of building, testing and refactoring pipelines and dbt models - Look for places where agents and automation can replace manual data work, and build them - Set standards for how AI tools touch production data: access, review, and what has to be verified by a human CROSS-FUNCTIONAL PARTNERSHIP - Work with Engineering on how data is produced, changed and retired at the source - Partner with Finance, FinOps, Product and GTM to understand the questions they need answered and decide which models get built first - Work in engineering-style cycle planning with clear goals, commitments and status updates WHO YOU ARE REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - 5+ years of data engineering experience, with a strong software engineering foundation - You have built and run a data stack end to end in production. That means ingestion, warehouse, transformation, orchestration, and keeping it running after launch, not just one layer of it - Deep hands-on dbt experience: model design, testing, macros, CI, and refactoring a large, messy project into something maintainable - Hands-on experience administering a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake preferred; BigQuery or Databricks considered), including permissions, performance tuning and cost management - Data contracts, data observability tooling (e.g. Metaplane, Monte Carlo, Elementary) - Expert SQL and strong data modeling skills (dimensional modeling, grain, slowly changing dimensions) - Strong Python for pipelines, automation and tooling - Experience with managed ingestion tools (e.g. Fivetran, Airbyte) and comfort working in AWS or GCP - Real day-to-day use of AI coding tools, plus a clear sense of where they help and where they get things wrong - A working foundation in analysis and statistics: you can take a business question, pull the data, sanity-check it, and present a clear answer without handing it off - You care about data quality and governance, and build things to last BONUS - Experience building semantic layers (dbt Semantic Layer / MetricFlow, Cube, Omni, LookML or similar) - Experience building or integrating LLM agents over structured data: text-to-SQL, MCP servers, retrieval over metric definitions - Experience designing evals for LLM output quality - Data science experience: forecasting, regression, cohort or churn modeling, experiment analysis - Experience running other data platforms beyond the warehouse, such as vector databases, time-series databases, ACID-compliant transactional databases, streaming systems (Kafka, Kinesis), and caches like Redis - Reverse ETL into Salesforce, NetSuite or HubSpot - Finance data experience: revenue, billing, COGS, cloud cost allocation - Experience in developer tools, API-first or infrastructure companies; video streaming or CDN background is a plus - Experience at a smaller company where you owned a broad scope WHAT MAKES YOU SUCCESSFUL - You're equally comfortable debugging a Snowflake warehouse bill and writing a dbt test - You think correct data matters more than clever AI, and you know the agent work only pays off once the data is right - You use AI to go faster and still verify the output - You see tech debt as something to remove, and you leave every codebase simpler than you found it - You take ownership of problems end to end, from root cause to fix to validation - You balance perfectionism with pragmatism: ship something good, then iterate - You build strong relationships across functions and can explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical people If you don't have all of these requirements but think your experience could be a great fit, that's okay! Please apply and we can talk about what's most needed in the role We have a supportive culture that cares about both excellent work and work-life balance. We have office spaces in Downtown San Francisco, New York City, and London U.S. BENEFITS - Flexible vacation + 11 company holidays - Weekly no-meeting days + quarterly focus weeks - Competitive health, dental, and vision insurance, including fertility - FSA and HSA available - Short-term and long-term disability insurance - Group life insurance - Travel accident insurance - 401(k) - Paid parental leave - Professional Development program - Lunch, internet, & ancillary equipment reimbursements UK BENEFITS - Competitive annual leave policy (25 days annual leave plus 8 public holidays) - Weekly no-meeting days + quarterly focus weeks - Private medical and dental insurance, and a vision stipend, including fertility - Short-term and long-term disability insurance - Group life assurance - Travel accident insurance - Matched Pension - Paid parental leave - Professional development program - Team social events - Lunch, cafe, & ancillary equipment reimbursements Mux is an Equal Opportunity employer committed to building a diverse company. We believe diversity makes us better, and we strive to be inclusive and equitable. That’s why we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description: Kit https://kit.com/ is the email marketing platform experts choose to grow their audience, deepen their relationships, and build a business around the work they love. For coaches, YouTubers, authors, podcasters, and other creatives, there isn't a better marketing hub to rely on to grow audiences, automate email marketing, and sell digital products — all within one platform. More importantly, there isn't a team more committed to helping creators earn a living. We're on a mission to help creators earn $1 billion using our creator marketing platform. We have always been 100% independent and 100% remote. We are proud to have built a product that our customers love, and we look for people who have enthusiasm and belief in our mission, vision, and values to join our team. We're also embracing AI thoughtfully — both in how we build and how we hire to ensure our team is adaptable, innovative, and ready for what's next. THE ROLE Our Sales team needs a dedicated data partner, and creator commerce https://kit.com/features/commerce (how creators monetize by selling digital products) is becoming a bigger part of how Kit and our creators scale. Kit is growing, so we're looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer to own Kit's sales and commerce data from end to end. Accurate sales data gives our team a clear picture of the pipeline and the confidence to make informed decisions. That’s what makes this role so important. Your primary focus will be Sales: the dbt models that turn our CRM data into trusted pipeline, deal, and funnel metrics, and the Omni dashboards our sales leader and Senior Revenue Operations Manager use to run the business. You'll also model creator commerce data, so we understand what creators sell and earn through Kit, and you'll pick up reporting work with our Product team, such as feature usage reporting. On a small data team, we step outside our usual lanes when the need is there, so the mix will shift over time. You'll build for two kinds of consumers: people and AI. Teammates increasingly answer their own questions by querying our semantic layer through Omni's AI and MCP connections to AI tools. That means your models, metric definitions, and documentation need to be clear and correct enough for an AI agent to use them without a data teammate in the loop. This is a full-time individual contributor role for someone who likes being close to the business, enjoys turning messy operational data into numbers people trust, and is happy to work on both the models and the dashboards that sit on top of them. When Sales and Product have clear, reliable data, we help more creators build more valuable businesses with Kit. YOUR SUPPORT SYSTEM You'll report to Sam Umachi, Head of Data (Linkedin https://www.linkedin.com/in/samuelumachi/). Sales and RevOps are your primary partners, who will rely on the models and reporting you own. You'll also partner with our Product team on reporting for features like Visual Automations https://kit.com/features/automations and on how creators use Kit. Within our data team, you'll work alongside a Staff Analytics Engineer who owns org-wide semantic layer governance and modeling standards, a Senior Data Engineer who owns ingestion and pipelines, and a Senior Business Analytics Partner focused on revenue opportunities. This role has no direct reports. WHAT YOU'LL DO - First Week: Work through our onboarding curriculum in Notion and meet the data team, our Senior Revenue Operations Manager, the sales team, and your product partners. Get set up in our core tools: dbt Cloud, GitHub, Amazon Redshift, Omni, HubSpot, Linear, Hightouch and Slack. Set up your AI-assisted development environment and learn the shared AI workflows our data team uses. Open and merge your first small pull request so you learn our review and deployment flow early. - First Month: Map how HubSpot objects (deals, pipelines and stages, companies, contacts, and owners) flow into our dbt models, and document the gaps. Take over day-to-day ownership of the sales models and Omni dashboards that teammates have been covering. Audit current sales reporting and list where definitions differ or numbers don't reconcile. Get familiar with how commerce data (products creators sell and the revenue they earn through Kit) lands in the warehouse today. Agree with RevOps and Sales on the most important questions they need answered. Review teammates' pull requests and contribute to our shared SQL, dbt, and documentation standards. Share a written reflection with the team on what you've learned and where you'd focus first. - First Six Months: Ship and maintain well-tested, documented dbt models for core sales metrics, such as pipeline, deal velocity, stage conversion, win rates, and the sales-led funnel. Expose those metrics through the Omni semantic layer, working within the team's governance standards. Rebuild or refresh the core sales dashboards so pipeline reviews and forecasting conversations run on numbers that don't need manual reconciliation. Resolve competing sales metric definitions by writing down the options and tradeoffs, aligning with Sales and RevOps, and documenting the outcome. Model creator-level commerce data, such as products sold, revenue earned through Kit, and conversion, in partnership with data engineering. Write semantic layer descriptions, metric definitions, and documentation that let Omni's AI and MCP-connected AI tools answer routine sales questions correctly, and test them against real questions from Sales, RevOps and Product. Get Sales to the point where routine questions are answered through self-serve, whether in Omni dashboards, Omni's AI, or AI tools connected over MCP, rather than one-off requests. - First Year: Be the recognized owner of Kit's sales data, the person Sales and RevOps go to first and trust without second-guessing. Give our revenue analysis work the sales and commerce models it depends on, so deeper questions about pipeline health and creator earnings can be answered quickly, thereby enabling us to make creators more successful. Leave your domains well documented and well tested, legible to new teammates, stakeholders, and the AI agents that query our semantic layer. Help raise the team's modeling quality through code review, pairing, and sharing what you learn. WHAT WILL S.E.T. YOU UP FOR SUCCESS Skills - Deep dbt experience. You build modular, tested, documented dbt projects, and you're comfortable with incremental models, snapshots, macros, CI, and scheduled jobs in dbt Cloud or similar. - Advanced SQL. You reason carefully about grain, joins, and window functions, and you write queries that are readable and performant on a cloud warehouse. - Data modeling for sales and GTM. You can model deals, pipeline stages and their history, ownership changes, and funnel conversion into clean, reusable structures. You are opinionated on Kimball standards and when a concept should be a fact or dimension. - CRM data fluency. You know how sales data behaves in a CRM, including stage changes, backdated edits, and custom properties. HubSpot is preferred, but other CRM experience (e.g. Salesforce) applies just as well. We care most that you recognize common CRM patterns. - AI-assisted development. You use AI code editors and agents (such as Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, or similar) every day, and you validate their output with tests, query results, and review before anything ships. - Clear written communication. You explain metric definitions, tradeoffs, and data caveats in plain language that Sales, RevOps, and Product partners understand. - BI and semantic layer experience. You can build dashboards and semantic models in Omni, Looker, or a similar BI tool, and you design metric definitions that people and AI tools can both query correctly. - Git-based workflows. You keep pull requests small and well described, and you give thoughtful code review. - Nice to have: Redshift performance tuning (sort and distribution keys), Python for scripting or API pulls, reverse ETL, and experience with product event, billing, payments, or ecommerce data. Experiences - Around 7 or more years in analytics engineering or data engineering where you personally shipped production data models. - Several years of hands-on work building and maintaining production dbt projects. - Working directly with sales teams and RevOps, and owning reporting they relied on to run the business. - Owning a data domain over time and evolving its models as the business and its questions changed. - Working at a SaaS company, ideally one with both a self-serve and a sales-led motion. Commerce, payments, or creator economy experience is a plus, not a requirement. - Working on a small or remote team where you were trusted to make decisions independently. Traits - Ownership and follow-through. You treat your data domains as yours. You notice problems before stakeholders do, close the loop on requests, and finish what you start. - Judgment. You match rigor to the decision at hand, know when a quick answer is enough and when a request should become a durable model, and say so clearly. - Flexibility. You're glad to step outside your primary area when another team needs help, and you balance that work against your core commitments openly. - Teach everything you know. You document as you go, pair generously, and help stakeholders understand the data well enough to use it on their own. - Work in public. You share progress, open questions, and decisions in writing where the team can see them, including what didn't work. - Creator success is our success. You remember who's on the other end. A wrong number in a pipeline review means Sales spends time on the wrong creators, and that shapes how carefully you work. - Do it with excellence. You test your work, review it carefully, and don't ship a number you can't defend. - Candor with care. You're comfortable pushing back when a request won't answer the real question, and you do it in a way that builds trust. WHAT WON'T SET YOU UP FOR SUCCESS - Needing detailed specs or a highly structured environment before you can start. - Discomfort with ambiguity. Some of our sales and commerce definitions are still evolving, and you'll help settle them. - Needing several layers of approval to make modeling decisions within your domain. - Wanting to work only on dashboards, or only on pipelines, rather than across the transformation and BI layers. - Wanting a strictly fixed scope. Sales comes first, but you'll pick up Product or other work when the business needs it. - Wanting mostly greenfield work. Much of this role is improving sales models and dashboards that already exist. - Preferring to take tickets as written rather than partnering with stakeholders on what they need. - Being skeptical of AI's capabilities, or using AI without good judgment and accountability. - Expecting a large data team with dedicated specialists for every part of the stack. WORKING HOURS AND LOCATION We're 100% remote with team members across the globe. We work mostly on East Coast time - so if you're based on the West Coast of the United States, Europe, or Asia, you might have a few early mornings or late evenings. We do our best to keep things reasonable, but a little time zone juggling comes with the territory. COMPENSATION + PERKS + BENEFITS Kit has standardized salaries based on position, no matter where you live. For this role, we're hiring at our level 4 ($172,000). Level is determined based on experience and our interview process. PERKS + BENEFITS INCLUDE: - Profit Sharing https://www.linkedin.com/feed/update/urn:li:activity:7454911054947688448/ - Kit equity - 401k with a 5% match - We cover up to $2,280 per month toward medical premiums, with dental and vision premiums fully covered. We offer Health Insurance plans through Aetna - $2,000 equipment allowance for your first two years, $1,000 budget every following two years. Company-provided laptops are issued to every Kit team member and are not included in the equipment budget - Individual learning + development budget ($3,500/year) - Creator meetup budget ($50/month) to connect with creators over coffee, lunch, or other in-person meetups - Gender affirming benefits - Childcare benefit up to $3,000 annually through JOON - Twenty (20) days of paid time off during each year of employment - Paid paid vacation: An after-tax bonus of $1,000 for taking five consecutive days of vacation where you’re fully unplugged from work - Ten (10) paid holidays a year - Two weeks of paid sick time each year, including mental health + well being days - Twelve (12) weeks paid parental leave and flexible scheduling in your child’s first year - Up to six weeks of paid bereavement leave, medical leave, and disaster after six months of employment, two weeks of each paid leave in your first six months - Winter Break Closure: Kit closes for a week at the end of December, giving everyone a collective break to enjoy the holiday season. Essential support services remain available, with teams coordinating to ensure coverage during this period - Four-week, paid sabbatical after five years with the team - Fantastic in-person or virtual retreats with the team twice a year HOW TO APPLY We usually receive a large number of applications, and our goal is to follow up with you within two weeks. You’ll hear from us either way. Here’s what you can expect from the rest of our hiring process: 1. A phone screen with our recruiter (30 min) 2. Hiring manager interview (45 min) 3. Take-home assignment 4. Technical interview (60 min) We’ll keep you informed through every step. To get started, complete this application, including a cover letter and answers to the questions on the next page. We read every single application, and your cover letter and responses help put your experience into context. Kit is an equal opportunity employer We value diversity in all of its forms. Research tells us that applicants who are female or non-binary, as well as applicants who are people of color, are less likely to apply for roles they do not feel 100% qualified for. If you think you meet more than 50% of our requirements but fewer than 100% of them, please apply. We’re imperfect communicators, so think of our job postings as the starting point for discussion rather than proof that you shouldn’t apply. Kit does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other reason prohibited by law in provision of employment opportunities and benefits.

title: Senior Analytics Engineer
description: At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers. We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in: We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to build the data models that teams across Instructure use to run the business. You'll work in dbt and Snowflake every day. You'll also sit in the room with business leaders, understand the decisions they're making, and design data that answers their questions correctly the first time. This role is broad by design. You'll support analytics across Finance, Operations, Product Management, Sales, and other parts of the company, so you'll see how the whole business fits together. It suits someone who writes clean SQL and also asks "what is this number used for?" before building it. You'll own models from source to dashboard, and you'll help set the standards for how we design, test, and document our data. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design, build, and maintain dimensional models in dbt and Snowflake that support reporting and analysis across Finance, Operations, Product Management, and other business functions. - Translate business questions into clear data requirements by working directly with senior leaders across the company. - Own the full model lifecycle: source ingestion patterns, staging, intermediate and mart layers, tests, documentation, and deployment. - Set and enforce modeling standards, including naming conventions, grain definitions, slowly changing dimension handling, and testing practices. - Tune Snowflake performance and cost through smart materialization choices, clustering, and warehouse sizing. - Partner with data engineers and business systems teams to make sure upstream data arrives in a shape we can model well. - Review pull requests, mentor analysts and engineers, and raise the quality bar across the team. - Explain data definitions and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences in plain language, and push back when a request would produce a misleading metric. WHAT YOU BRING - 5+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a similar role. - A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or another quantitative field is preferred. - Deep, hands-on experience with dbt, including macros, packages, incremental models, snapshots, and testing. - Strong Snowflake skills, with advanced SQL and a good sense of performance and cost. - Proven experience designing dimensional models (star schemas, facts, dimensions, conformed dimensions) and a clear point of view on when to use them and when not to. - Solid data architecture instincts: layered modeling, grain, lineage, data contracts, and maintainable project structure. - Working knowledge of how a business operates across functions such as finance, sales, operations, and product, ideally in a SaaS company. - The ability to hold a credible conversation with directors, VPs, and executives about business issues, and to turn that conversation into a data solution. - Strong written and verbal communication. You document your work and explain it well. - Experience with Git-based workflows and CI/CD for data projects. NICE TO HAVE - Experience modeling data from CRM and other business systems such as Salesforce. - Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Airflow or dbt Cloud. - Experience with a BI tool such as Tableau, Looker, or Power BI. - Background in a SaaS or education technology company. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE - In 90 days, you've shipped your first production models and built working relationships with partners in several business functions. - In 6 months, you own a major domain in our data model and the business trusts the numbers it produces. - In a year, you've shaped our modeling standards and made the whole team faster. Get in on all the awesome at Instructure! We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect: - Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success. - Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location. - Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs. - Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support - Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth - The technology and tools you need to do your best work - Motivosity employee recognition program - A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes. Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate. All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws. Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

title: Data Engineer
description: About Curve Dental: Curve Dental builds cloud-based practice management software for dental offices. More than 8,000 practices across North America run on our three brands — Curve, Flex Dental, and DentalHQ — along with our embedded payments products, Curve Pay and Flex Payments. The role We are looking for a full-time Data Engineer to own the data platforms that finance, sales, and customer success run the business on. This position will report directly to the CFO and work closely with leaders across the company. Snowflake is our warehouse and Tableau our reporting layer. We are modernizing how data gets in and how it is transformed, and you will help lead that work. Your job is to make the platform reliable, extend it to every core system, and deliver a single trusted view of each customer. Occasional travel may be required to one of our Corporate office locations (Georgia and Utah) What you'll do in year one Build Customer360. Design and deliver a unified customer model in Snowflake that ties together contracts, billing, payments, product usage, support, and sales activity. Every team should be able to answer "what is happening with this practice?" from one source. Harden the warehouse. Modernize ingestion and stand up a transformation layer, then make the pipeline reliable: automated testing, alerting, and documented recovery when a load fails Own data models and metric definitions so finance and operating reports tie out Manage Snowflake performance and credit spend; report usage and cost monthly Set up access controls, environments (dev/prod), and version control practices Integrate core source systems. Bring and maintain, modeled data from Salesforce, Maxio, Stripe, Gong, and NetSuite into Snowflake, and resolve customer identity across them. Support reporting. Partner with finance and RevOps to ensure dashboards and board metrics run on governed, tested data. What you bring Required 3–6 years in data engineering, with at least 2 years running production workloads on Snowflake Strong knowledge and skills in SQL and Python Hands-on experience with a modern transformation framework such as dbt: modeling, testing, documentation Experience with managed ELT tools (such as Fivetran or Airbyte), including migrating pipelines between tools A track record of building dimensional or entity models that business users trust Comfortable working directly with non-technical stakeholders and translating business questions into data design Nice to have SaaS data: subscriptions, billing, ARR, churn Salesforce data model experience; exposure to Maxio, Stripe, or NetSuite data Snowflake cost management (warehouses, resource monitors, query tuning) SnowPro certification Experience as the first or only data engineer at a growing company How we work This role sits at the center of how the business runs, so responsiveness and clear communication matter as much as technical skill. We are explicit about what that means: Dedicated role. This is a full-time position with Curve Dental as your sole employer; no concurrent client or consulting work. Core hours. Available 10:00 a.m.–4:00 p.m. Eastern, Monday through Friday, regardless of your home time zone. Response times. Be a responsive, reliable partner to Sales, Account Management, and Finance: acknowledge requests promptly, follow up the same day, and treat production issues as a top priority. Visible work. All work lives in a shared backlog with status kept current. Changes go through version control and code review. Weekly cadence. A 30-minute priorities meeting with the CFO each week, plus a short written status update. Written first. Document and explain the logic behind every model and report you build: the assumptions, data sources, definitions, and calculations, so others can understand, trust, and maintain it Raise issues early. If a deadline is at risk or a request is unclear, say so the same day rather than at the deadline. Compensation and benefits We offer a competitive base salary and annual bonus, benchmarked to the market for this role and level. Benefits include health, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k), paid time off, and a home-office setup for remote work.
